# Synology NAS (File Search) MCP connector

Search inside the shared folders of a Synology NAS from your AI client over SFTP or WebDAV: full-text index of PDF, Excel, Word and Outlook files, synced in the background. The AnythingMCP connector gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini 10 MCP tools for Synology NAS (File Search).

[![Open Synology NAS (File Search) in AnythingMCP Cloud](https://img.shields.io/badge/Open%20in-AnythingMCP%20Cloud-1f6feb?style=for-the-badge)](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com/login?mode=register&redirect=%2Fconnectors%2Fstore%3Finstall%3Dsynology-file-search&utm_source=github&utm_medium=catalog&utm_campaign=synology-file-search)

## Start without code

No installation and no terminal: AnythingMCP Cloud runs the Synology NAS (File Search) connector for you, operated by helpcode.ai in Frankfurt, Germany.

1. **Click the button above** and create an account or sign in. The Synology NAS (File Search) connector opens, ready to install.
2. **Paste the API key or token from your Synology NAS (File Search) account.** Every click is in the [step-by-step guide](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/synology-file-search).
3. **Click Install.** AnythingMCP shows the address of your MCP server.
4. **Add that address to your assistant:** [Claude](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-synology-file-search-to-claude) · [ChatGPT](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-synology-file-search-to-chatgpt) · [Microsoft Copilot](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-synology-file-search-to-copilot) · [Cursor](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-synology-file-search-to-cursor) · [Gemini CLI](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-synology-file-search-to-gemini) · [Meta Muse](https://anythingmcp.com/guides/connect-synology-file-search-to-muse).
5. **Ask your first question**, for example: *Show me invoice INV-2026-114 (PDF) for client Olav Hansen, I need date and total.*

Prefer help with the setup? [Talk to us](https://anythingmcp.com/contact).

## How it works

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  client["Claude · ChatGPT · Copilot · Cursor"]
  amcp["AnythingMCP<br/>roles · audit log · encrypted credentials"]
  api["Synology NAS (File Search) API"]
  client -- "MCP, OAuth or API key" --> amcp
  amcp -- "HTTPS, user name and password" --> api
```

- **The AI client** speaks MCP (Streamable HTTP) to AnythingMCP and only sees tool names, descriptions and results. It never gets the Synology NAS (File Search) credentials.
- **AnythingMCP** checks the client's role, builds the call from the tool definition, adds the credentials (user name and password), calls Synology NAS (File Search), logs the call and returns the result.
- **Synology NAS (File Search)** sees an ordinary API client with the rights of the account the credentials belong to.

## Run it yourself

AnythingMCP is open source (AGPL-3.0). [Run it with Docker](../../../README.md#run-it-yourself), open **Connectors → Store**, pick **Synology NAS (File Search)**, then add your MCP server URL to the AI client.
